Field
Description
BrowserExtensionVersion
The browser extension version.
BrowserVersion
The User Agent of the browser generating the event.
IsAllowedIncognitoAccess
Set to true if the user has enabled the browser extension in incognito.
IsAllowedFileSchemeAccess Set to true if the user has enabled file scheme access.
RawTargetProcessId
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID of the
process that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that performed
thread injection in an InjectedThread event
